content: Sentry Next 16 App Router: instrumentation.ts exports register() importing sentry.server/edge config (gated on NEXT_RUNTIME) and 'export const onRequestError = Sentry.captureRequestError' to capture RSC/middleware/route errors (needs SDK>=8.28, Next>=15). Client init moved to instrumentation-client.ts (Next 15.3+) with onRouterTransitionStart. Wrap next.config with withSentryConfig (org/project/authToken for sourcemaps). Worker uses @sentry/node init first. @sentry/nextjs+@sentry/node 10.61.0.
